info.title: Verkada Access API (baton-verkada connector surface)
info.description: Describes only the Verkada API endpoints called by the baton-verkada connector (pkg/verkada/client.go). This is not the full Verkada API -- see https://apidocs.verkada.com for the complete reference.

servers.description: US region (default). Selected when the connector's `region` config field is "US" or unset.
EU region. Selected when the connector's `region` config field is "EU".

post.summary: Exchange an API key for a short-lived API token
post.description: Called internally by the connector's doRequest helper before any authenticated request, whenever no token is cached or the cached token is older than 25 minutes (pkg/verkada/client.go:165, getToken at client.go:197). The vendor-issued token is valid for 30 minutes; the connector refreshes early to avoid using an expired one.

get.description: Called by Client.ListUsers (pkg/verkada/client.go:47), used both for Verkada.Validate (connector.go:38) and userBuilder.List (pkg/connector/users.go:55). No pagination is applied by the connector -- the full list is read in a single call.

get.summary: Get a single user's access information
get.description: Implemented by Client.GetUserAccessInformation (pkg/verkada/client.go:62). Defined on the client but not currently invoked by any resource syncer or by Validate -- kept in scope because it is a request site in client.go. The vendor API also accepts external_id, email, and employee_id as alternate lookup keys; the connector only ever supplies user_id.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Verkada-defined user identifier. The only lookup key this connector sends.

get.description: Called by Client.ListAccessGroups (pkg/verkada/client.go:92), used by groupBuilder.List (pkg/connector/groups.go:54). No pagination is applied by the connector. Per vendor docs, each item in this list response carries only group_id and name -- user_ids is not populated here (it is only present on the single-group GET).

get.summary: Get a single access group, including its member user IDs
get.description: Called by Client.GetAccessGroup (pkg/verkada/client.go:77), used by groupBuilder.Grants (pkg/connector/groups.go:86) to enumerate group membership.

200.description: The access group, including member user IDs.

put.summary: Add a user to an access group
put.description: Called by Client.AddUserToGroup (pkg/verkada/client.go:107), used by groupBuilder.Grant (pkg/connector/groups.go:118) to provision group membership. The vendor API accepts either user_id or external_id in the request body; the connector always sends user_id. The connector treats the user's ID appearing in `unsuccessful_adds` as a failure (pkg/verkada/client.go:133).

delete.summary: Remove a user from an access group
delete.description: Called by Client.RemoveUserFromGroup (pkg/verkada/client.go:141), used by groupBuilder.Revoke (pkg/connector/groups.go:140) to deprovision group membership. The connector does not decode a response body for DELETE requests (pkg/verkada/client.go:188) -- it only checks the HTTP status code.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Verkada-defined user identifier. The vendor API also accepts external_id as an alternate; the connector always sends user_id.

200.description: User removed from the group. No response body is parsed by the connector.

VerkadaApiKey.name: x-api-key
VerkadaApiKey.description: Top-level, long-lived API key (connector config field `api-key` / BATON_API_KEY). Used only to call POST /token.

VerkadaAuthToken.name: x-verkada-auth
VerkadaAuthToken.description: Short-lived API token obtained from POST /token (pkg/verkada/client.go:197). Sent on every other request (pkg/verkada/client.go:176). Cached in-process and refreshed after 25 minutes.

User.description: Access user. Fields reflect only what pkg/verkada/models.go:3 (User struct) declares -- the vendor response also includes external_id, company_name, department, department_id, employee_title, is_visitor, has_profile_photo, and profile_photo_last_updated, none of which this connector reads.

Group.description: Access group. pkg/verkada/models.go:21. user_ids is only populated by GET /access/v1/access_groups/group; GET /access/v1/access_groups omits it.

UserAccess.description: pkg/verkada/models.go:10. Fields reflect only what the UserAccess struct declares.

end_date.description: Unix timestamp as a string. Vendor docs mark this nullable; the Go field is a non-pointer string, so a JSON null is silently decoded as the zero value ("") rather than surfaced -- unproven whether the connector ever observes this in practice.

external_id.description: Vendor docs type this as a string, but the Go field is declared as interface{} (pkg/verkada/models.go:15), accepting any JSON type.

start_date.description: Vendor docs type this as a nullable string (Unix timestamp); the Go field is declared as interface{} (pkg/verkada/models.go:17), accepting any JSON type including null.

AddUserToGroupRequest.description: pkg/verkada/client.go:26 (RequestBody) / client.go:120. Vendor API accepts user_id or external_id (exactly one); the connector only ever populates user_id.

unsuccessful_adds.description: If the target user_id appears here, Client.AddUserToGroup returns an error (pkg/verkada/client.go:133).
